newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae debt issue $750 bln '96 - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae debt issue $750 bln '96 - CEO.

text.p: The Federal National Mortgage Association is expected to issue a total of $750 billion of debt this year, James Johnson, chairman and chief executive officer, said Thursday.

"This year Fannie Mae will issue $750 billion of debt through the capital markets," he said at a National Press Club luncheon. "We will be using that money to finance the work that we do in housing," he added.
Johnson said Fannie Mae was "well-capitalized" and in looking at a recent law on setting capital standards, "we believe ... we will satisfy those standards."
